statement: An UNANCHORED glob (`*-<qslug>.md`) is WRONG: `*` matches any text, so a short question's slug can match as a mere SUFFIX of an unrelated, longer, older record's slug.
reason: `*-queue.md` matches '...-message-queue.md' because it ends in '-queue.md'; the two are unrelated decisions ('queue?' vs 'how should the team pick a message queue?'). Reusing the older file would silently overwrite it -- the regression this glob-anchoring rule exists to prevent.
note: Verified against record_filename() on v0.8.3: the correct output is a brand-new file, NOT the longer-slug file.
